scope: Encoded CTD IND/NDA/BLA lifecycle catalogue only; no initial-IND requirement or scientific qualification is inferred.

derivation.terminal: A code has no modeled descendant with the code plus dot as prefix in the union of exact guidance and structural headings.
derivation.structure_only: A terminal is in ICH_M4_HEADINGS and has no exact CTD_AUTHORING_GUIDANCE entry.
derivation.ancestor: Longest dot-delimited strict prefix present in CTD_AUTHORING_GUIDANCE; verified against resolveSectionBriefSource.
derivation.applicability: Every row remains undetermined; neither structural presence nor ancestor necessity tags resolve initial IND applicability.
